summary: Hafnia Limited, a Singapore-domiciled, NYSE- and Oslo-listed tanker owner, furnished a Form 6-K reporting the results of an Extraordinary General Meeting held September 23, 2026 at its registered office. The sole resolution, appointing Mr. Mikael Østun Skov as a Director, passed. No special-situation transaction is disclosed: there is no stake, price, premium, or deal terms. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer meeting-result notice under the Norwegian Securities Trading Act. Watch for future board or governance changes, but no risk-arb angle exists here.
